children: M/M to $958.9B, compared with the +1.3% consensus and +0.4% in June (revised from +0.2%), according to data released by the U.S. Census Bureau on Thursday.
From a year ago, July wholesale inventories grew 5.7%, accelerating from the 4.2% Y/Y increase in June.
Sales of merchant wholesalers, except manufacturers' sales branches and offices, advanced 0.8% M/M to $801.3B vs. 3.5% in June. The July level increased 13.0% from July 2025.
The inventories/sales ratio was 1.20 in July 2026 vs. 1.19 in June and 1.28 in July 2025, the Census Bureau said.

title: Wholesale inventories accelerate, as expected, in July
